query.text:
if dbo.FastBusiness$Function$CheckSQLInjection(@stt_rec) = 0 return
declare @m_ma_nt0 varchar(10), @bilingual tinyint, @l char(1) declare @consolidatingGroup char(16), @companyParent char(8), @ten_cty nvarchar(512), @ten_cty2 nvarchar(512), @dia_chi nvarchar(1024), @ten_ktt nvarchar(512)
if @@form in ('011', '111') select @bilingual = 1, @l = 'V' else select @bilingual = 0, @l = @@language select @m_ma_nt0 = val from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0'
select @consolidatingGroup = nhom_hn from cfphdc3 a with(nolock) where stt_rec = @stt_rec select @companyParent = ma_cty_me from cfdmnhomhn where ma_nh = @consolidatingGroup select @ten_cty = ten_cty, @ten_cty2 = ten_cty2, @dia_chi = dia_chi, @ten_ktt = ten_ktt from cfdmcty where ma_cty = @companyParent
select @ten_cty as ten_cty, @ten_cty2 as ten_cty2, @dia_chi as dia_chi, @ten_ktt as ten_ktt, ltrim(so_ct) as so_ct, dien_giai, t_tien, t_tien_nt, ma_cty_lk, b.ten_cty as ten_cty_lk, b.ten_cty2 as ten_cty_lk2, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(@m_ma_nt0, t_tien, @l) as t_tien_in_word, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tien_nt, @l) as t_tien_nt_in_word, case when @bilingual = 1 then dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(@m_ma_nt0, t_tien, 'E') else '' end as t_tien_in_word2, case when @bilingual = 1 then dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tien_nt, 'E') else '' end as t_tien_nt_in_word2, replace(str(day(ngay_ct),2),' ','0') ngay, replace(str(month(ngay_ct),2),' ','0') thang, cast(year(ngay_ct) as char(4)) nam from cfphdc3 a with(nolock) left join cfdmctyld b on a.ma_cty_lk = b.ma_cty where stt_rec = @stt_rec
declare @key varchar(128) select @key = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + '''' exec rs_PrintCFDC3Tran @@language, @key, 'cfctdc3', @@id, @bilingual
&Conditional.Unit.Profile.Query.Declare; &Conditional.Unit.Profile.Query.Select; &Conditional.Unit.Profile.Query.Result;
